verdicts.reason: A fills the banner well: a big quote mark on the left and a bold three-line headline. But 'Rated 5 out of 5' is squeezed into an awkward three-line stack ('Rated / 5 out / of 5') that is bigger than the cyan source credit and competes with it, the bottom row looks crowded, and the logo is small and centred apart from the left-aligned copy. B squeezes everything into a small block right of centre with a tiny quote mark and a smaller headline. Its source credit is jammed under the headline at an unreadable size, the logo sits bottom-left out of line with that block, and the left third of the canvas is dead space, so it reads as a shrunk copy, not a rearranged layout.
